name: coveragepy-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `coverage.py`, the code coverage tool for Python: it measures which
lines and branches of a program run, reads its settings from configuration files, the command
line and the API, stores and combines measurement data in SQLite data files, decides which files
to measure and which lines to exclude, and reports the results as text, annotated source, HTML,
XML, JSON and LCOV.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the coverage.py measurement library and its command line: every module under coverage/ other than coverage/__main__.py, the C tracer sources under coverage/ctracer/ and the HTML report assets under coverage/htmlfiles/, together with README.rst, the documentation pages under doc/ named api, api_coverage, api_coveragedata, api_exceptions, api_module, api_plugin, branch, config, contexts, dbschema, excluding, faq, howitworks, index, messages, migrating, plugins, source, subprocess and trouble, every page under doc/commands/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are onl
